points.K1: 测验规则：十题八对才过关
points.K6: 感烟探测器一年测两次

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台空白屏幕的电脑旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a computer with a blank screen and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 消防小测验，十分钟八题过关！
overlay: 消防小测验：十分钟八题过关

shots.scene: 阿杰坐在电脑前，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits in front of a computer with a blank screen.
shots.narration: 阿杰要准备单位面试的消防考试。

shots.scene: 小研指着屏幕上的目录图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a list of blank menu icons on the screen.
shots.narration: 小研说：先看看防火要点再答题。

shots.scene: 灶台上的锅、旁边的毛巾和定时器
shots.prompt_en: A pot on a stove, a towel moved away and a kitchen timer. No people.
shots.narration: 做饭时人别走开，易燃物远离灶台。

shots.prompt_en: A kitchen timer icon rings. No people.
shots.narration: 用定时器提醒自己，别忘了锅。

shots.scene: 目录图标：火灾原因、隐患、灭火器、演练、疏散
shots.prompt_en: Menu icons: a fire cause, a hazard sign, an extinguisher, a drill and an exit. No people.
shots.narration: 还要了解火因、识别隐患、选对灭火器。

shots.prompt_en: Person icons follow evacuation arrows out of a building. No people.
shots.narration: 参加消防演练，掌握疏散程序。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过关
shots.scene: 屏幕上十格进度条和倒计时
shots.prompt_en: A screen with a ten-segment progress bar and a countdown timer. No people.
shots.narration: 测验共十题，限时十分钟。
overlay: 测验规则：十题八对才过关

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过关
shots.scene: 进度条每答一题前进一格
shots.prompt_en: The progress bar moves forward one segment per answer. No people.
shots.narration: 答一题前进一格，答错还能返回改。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过关
shots.prompt_en: The young male student clicks answers very quickly without reading.
shots.narration: 阿杰没细看，一路点了下去。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过关
shots.prompt_en: A result screen with three green boxes and seven red boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 结果只得30%，没有通过。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过关
shots.scene: 进度条在八成处插一面小旗
shots.prompt_en: A progress bar with a flag at four fifths. No people.
shots.narration: 要答对八题、达到80%才能过。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过关
shots.scene: 结果页逐题显示红绿，旁边重做按钮
shots.prompt_en: The result screen shows each question in red or green, with a restart button. No people.
shots.narration: 交卷后每题显示对错，还能重做。

shots.prompt_en: One wall outlet crowded with many plugs. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：怎样防止插座过载起火？

shots.scene: 插满、插线板分担、一座一台三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an outlet full of plugs, an extension cord and one outlet with one heater plug. No people.
shots.narration: 插满省时间？用延长线分担？一座一台？

shots.prompt_en: The one-outlet-one-heater icon lights up green. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：一个插座只插一台大功率电器。

shots.prompt_en: Grease in a kitchen pan catches fire. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：厨房油脂火用哪种灭火器？

shots.prompt_en: Three fire extinguishers with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: B类、C类，还是A类灭火器？

shots.prompt_en: The first extinguisher lights up green. No people.
shots.narration: 网页给的答案：B类灭火器。

shots.prompt_en: A fire next to a gasoline can and an oil bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：汽油、油类等易燃液体火是？

shots.prompt_en: The first class card lights up green. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：B类火。

shots.section_title: 感烟探测器一年测两次
shots.scene: 天花板上的感烟探测器，旁边日历
shots.prompt_en: A ceiling smoke detector next to a calendar. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：感烟探测器多久测试一次？
overlay: 感烟探测器一年测两次

shots.section_title: 感烟探测器一年测两次
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with two marks in a year. No people.
shots.narration: 网页给的答案：一年两次。

shots.scene: 一块金属燃起白亮火焰
shots.prompt_en: A piece of metal burning with a bright white flame. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：镁、钾等金属引起的火是？

shots.prompt_en: The D class card lights up green. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：D类火。

shots.scene: 维修电器、破旧电线、无人蜡烛三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: maintaining an appliance, frayed wiring and an unattended candle. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：哪项不是常见的火灾原因？

shots.prompt_en: The appliance maintenance icon lights up green. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：定期维护电器。

shots.prompt_en: The wiring and candle icons glow red. No people.
shots.narration: 线路故障和无人看管的蜡烛才会起火。

shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard.
shots.narration: 十题十分钟，答对八题才过关。

shots.prompt_en: Icons of an outlet and a grease pan. No people.
shots.narration: 一座一台大功率，油脂火用B类。

shots.prompt_en: Icons of a liquid, a metal and a smoke detector. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃液体B类，金属D类，探测器一年测两次。

shots.prompt_en: The young male student clicks the restart button.
shots.narration: 先读懂要点，再认真做一遍。

shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 消防小测验到这里，下次见！
